verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS compliance platform with a desktop agent, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented setting to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The agent's read-only system-preferences access is an adjacent behavior, not an opt-out. Community suggestions to isolate the agent in a VM or on a dedicated laptop are user-side workarounds and earn no credit.
